query.statement: SELECT PURCHASE_ORDER_ID, PLANT_ID, PURCHASE_ORDER_NAME, VENDOR_ID, ORDER_DATE, INCOMING_DATE, ORDER_QTY, OWNER_ID, STATUS, IS_HOLD FROM PRC_PURCHASE_ORDER WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE (@plantId IS NULL OR PLANT_ID = @plantId) AND (@status IS NULL OR STATUS = @status) AND (@vendorId IS NULL OR VENDOR_ID = @vendorId) ORDER BY ORDER_DATE DESC

-- 그리드 표준 편집(upsert) — PK 존재 시 UPDATE(CREATED_*는 최초 등록 정보 보존). MERGE PRC_PURCHASE_ORDER AS t USING (SELECT @purchaseOrderId AS PURCHASE_ORDER_ID) AS s ON t.PURCHASE_ORDER_ID = s.PURCHASE_ORDER_ID WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET PLANT_ID = @plantId, PURCHASE_ORDER_NAME = @purchaseOrderName, VENDOR_ID = @vendorId, ORDER_QTY = @orderQty, UPDATED_BY = @currentUser, UPDATED_AT = @utcNow WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (PURCHASE_ORDER_ID, PLANT_ID, PURCHASE_ORDER_NAME, VENDOR_ID, ORDER_QTY, CREATED_BY, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_BY, UPDATED_AT) VALUES (@purchaseOrderId, @plantId, @purchaseOrderName, @vendorId, @orderQty, @currentUser, @utcNow, @currentUser, @utcNow);
UPDATE PRC_PURCHASE_ORDER SET STATUS = 'Ordered', UPDATED_BY = @currentUser, UPDATED_AT = @utcNow WHERE PURCHASE_ORDER_ID = @purchaseOrderId AND STATUS = 'Draft'
UPDATE PRC_PURCHASE_ORDER SET STATUS = 'Closed', UPDATED_BY = @currentUser, UPDATED_AT = @utcNow WHERE PURCHASE_ORDER_ID = @purchaseOrderId AND STATUS IN ('Ordered', 'Incoming')
